purpose: Define and execute representative benchmark workloads for each discovered engine to enable apples-to-apples comparison

benchmark_protocol.judge: Claude Sonnet 4.6 (main agent) scores quality on 1-5 rubric
benchmark_protocol.environment: macOS 12.7.6 Intel Mac mini, same conditions each run

findings.purpose: Antfarm is a multi-agent workflow orchestration engine deeply integrated with OpenClaw. It provides structured, repeatable AI agent team workflows (bug-fix, feature-dev, security-audit) with a planner, developer, verifier, tester, reviewer model. Built for OpenClaw as an optional extension — install via single command.
entry_points: Per-workflow agent cron jobs — self-advancing polling loop

modules.db: SQLite schema + migration (runs, steps, stories tables)

test_coverage.assessment: Sparse — core installer/run/step-ops not tested. Tests exist only for CLI interface, logger, status display, and uninstall paths.

findings: Uses execFile() (not exec()) for agent invocation — shell injection safe
Gateway credentials sourced from ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json — no hardcoded secrets
Secret resolution: password mode vs token mode — reads from env var OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PASSWORD as override
Network calls only to local gateway (127.0.0.1:{port}) — no external network during runtime
Workflow install fetches from GitHub via workflow-fetch.ts — supply chain risk at install time
WAL-mode SQLite for concurrent access — good practice
No eval(), no dynamic shell construction detected
risks: Supply chain: workflow YAML fetched from GitHub on install — no signature verification detected
Gateway auth token written to disk in openclaw.json — protected by filesystem perms only

details: Provisions agents into OpenClaw via gateway-api.ts (http://127.0.0.1:{port}/tools/invoke)
Installs cron jobs registered in OpenClaw agent polling system
Uses OpenClaw subagent allowlist for workflow step permissions
SKILL.md registered as OpenClaw skill at ~/.openclaw/plugin-skills/antfarm-workflows/

findings.capability_provided: Self-advancing multi-agent development workflows. Eliminates manual coordination overhead for structured coding tasks. Provides retry/escalation, fresh context per step, and agent specialization (planner≠developer≠verifier). Primary use: automating the bug-fix and feature-dev loops that would otherwise require manual orchestration.

recommendation.rationale: Antfarm is the only structured multi-agent development workflow engine in the Open Empire stack. It fills a genuine capability gap — deterministic, retrying, multi-specialist AI pipelines — that neither OpenClaw orchestrator nor Claude Code cover natively. Its deep OpenClaw integration means it works out-of-box with existing auth/config. The 60KB database with prior runs confirms active prior use.
upgrade_actions: ADD: test coverage for core installer/run/step-ops modules (current ~14% file coverage is inadequate)
ADD: formal test for workflow install + cron registration cycle
ADD: signature/hash verification for fetched workflow YAML (supply chain risk)
CONSIDER: additional workflow templates (e.g., code-review, refactor, deploy)
CONSIDER: PM2 daemon integration for always-on agent polling (remove cron dependency)
MONITOR: node:sqlite experimental warning — stable in Node 22+ but watch for breakage
recommendation.remove_conditions: Remove only if antfarm project abandoned AND alternative orchestration engine (e.g. n8n + Claude Code) provides equivalent structured workflow capability.

W2_BUG_FIX_WORKFLOW.name: Bug-Fix Workflow — Antfarm
W2_BUG_FIX_WORKFLOW.description: Run the built-in 'bug-fix' workflow on a seeded bug in a test repo
W2_BUG_FIX_WORKFLOW.command_template: node ~/.openclaw/workspace/antfarm/dist/cli/cli.js workflow run bug-fix 'Fix the NullPointerException in auth.js'
W2_BUG_FIX_WORKFLOW.success_criterion: Workflow completes all 6 steps, bug is fixed in output
W2_BUG_FIX_WORKFLOW.prerequisite: Seeded test repo with known bug
W2_BUG_FIX_WORKFLOW.blocker: No seeded test repo available — requires setup

W3_CLAUDE_CODE_BUG_FIX.name: Single-File Bug Fix — Claude Code
W3_CLAUDE_CODE_BUG_FIX.description: Given a Python file with 3 intentional bugs (type error, off-by-one, wrong dict key), fix all bugs without breaking other code
W3_CLAUDE_CODE_BUG_FIX.success_criterion: All 3 bugs fixed, tests pass, no regressions
W3_CLAUDE_CODE_BUG_FIX.prerequisite: Test file with seeded bugs at ~/.openclaw/workspace/benchmarks/testbed/

W4_CODEBASE_NAV_QA.name: Codebase Navigation Q&A — Claude Code
W4_CODEBASE_NAV_QA.description: Answer 5 factual questions about a 1000-line codebase (function names, logic flow, config values)
W4_CODEBASE_NAV_QA.success_criterion: 5/5 correct answers verified against ground truth

W5_CODEX_CODE_GENERATION.name: Code Generation from Spec — OpenAI Codex CLI

W5_CODEX_CODE_GENERATION.command_template: codex 'Write a Python BankAccount class with deposit, withdraw, balance methods and proper error handling'
W5_CODEX_CODE_GENERATION.success_criterion: Class is syntactically valid, all methods present, error handling correct

W6_N8N_WEBHOOK_PIPELINE.name: HTTP Webhook to Telegram — n8n

W6_N8N_WEBHOOK_PIPELINE.prerequisite: n8n now confirmed RUNNING — can proceed
